name: guard-mcp
description: Security intelligence MCP server for AI agents

scripts.build:bin: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --compress GZip --output dist/bin/guardmcp
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --compress GZip --output dist/bin/guardmcp-win-x64.exe
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node18-linux-x64 --compress GZip --output dist/bin/guardmcp-linux-x64
scripts.build:macos: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node18-macos-x64,node18-macos-arm64 --compress GZip --output dist/bin/guardmcp-macos
scripts.build:macos-arm64: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node18-macos-arm64 --compress GZip --output dist/bin/guardmcp-macos-arm64
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node18-win-x64,node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-macos-arm64 --compress GZip --output dist/bin/guardmcp
